headline: **MLB Daily Roundup: July 6, 2026**
article:
The MLB season continues to heat up, with several thrilling matchups and key injuries affecting teams across the league.

Top MLB News

The New York Mets edged out the Atlanta Braves in a high-scoring 10-9 victory, with Drake Baldwin leading the Mets' offense. The Pittsburgh Pirates secured a convincing 11-5 win over the Washington Nationals, with Brandon Lowe hitting a home run and driving in three runs. The Cincinnati Reds edged out the Baltimore Orioles 3-2, with Spencer Steer leading the Reds' offense. The Minnesota Twins took down the New York Yankees 6-1, with Joe Ryan earning the win. The Kansas City Royals dominated the Philadelphia Phillies 15-1 in a blowout victory.

Injuries and Availability Impact

Several key players have been placed on the injured list, affecting their teams' lineups. Max Rajcic, a right-handed pitcher for the St. Louis Cardinals, has been placed on the 15-day injured list due to right elbow soreness. Martín Pérez, a left-handed pitcher for the Atlanta Braves, has been placed on the 15-day injured list with a left forearm contusion. Brandon Woodruff, a right-handed pitcher for the Milwaukee Brewers, has been placed on the 15-day injured list with right shoulder inflammation.

Trades and Roster Movement

Several trades have been made, affecting teams' rosters. Matt Seelinger, a right-handed pitcher, has been traded from the Detroit Tigers to the New York Mets for cash. Woo-Suk Go, a right-handed pitcher, has been traded from the Detroit Tigers to the Minnesota Twins for cash. Ryan Degges, a right-handed pitcher, has been traded from the Philadelphia Phillies to the Cleveland Guardians for cash. Tom Cosgrove, a left-handed pitcher, has been traded from the Houston Astros to the Washington Nationals for cash.

top_news.title: **Mets Edge Braves in Thrilling 10-9 Victory**
top_news.summary: The New York Mets outlasted the Atlanta Braves in a high-scoring matchup, winning 10-9. Drake Baldwin led the Mets' offense with 2 hits, 1 home run, and 4 RBIs.

top_news.title: **Pirates Cruise Past Nationals 11-5**
top_news.summary: The Pittsburgh Pirates secured a convincing 11-5 victory over the Washington Nationals, with Brandon Lowe leading the offense. Lowe hit a home run and drove in three runs, while Eddy Yean pitched two scoreless innings in relief.

top_news.title: **Reds Take Down Orioles in Thrilling Finish**
top_news.summary: The Cincinnati Reds edged out the Baltimore Orioles 3-2, securing a crucial win. Spencer Steer led the Reds' offense with a home run and two RBIs, while Nick Lodolo pitched 6 strong innings, earning the win.

top_news.title: **Twins Take Down Yankees 6-1**
top_news.summary: The Minnesota Twins secured a 6-1 victory over the New York Yankees, with Joe Ryan earning the win after pitching 7.0 innings with 9 strikeouts and 0 earned runs. Royce Lewis led the Twins' offense with 2 hits and 2 RBIs.

top_news.title: **Royals Rout Phillies in Blowout Victory**
top_news.summary: The Kansas City Royals dominated the Philadelphia Phillies 15-1, handing them a one-sided loss.

top_news.title: **Cardinals' Rajcic Lands on 15-Day IL**
top_news.summary: St. Louis Cardinals right-handed pitcher Max Rajcic has been placed on the 15-day injured list due to right elbow soreness, with the move retroactive to July 4, 2026.

top_news.title: **Mets Acquire RHP Matt Seelinger in Trade**
top_news.summary: The New York Mets have acquired right-handed pitcher Matt Seelinger in a trade with the Detroit Tigers, who received cash in return.
